stem: Based on the excerpt, which statement reflects Representative Wadsworth's fear about the passage of the Social Security Act?

options.label: A
options.text: U.S. businesses would be unable to hire new employees.

options.label: B
options.text: The program would favor employment in government over jobs in private business.

options.label: C
options.text: U.S. citizens would experience unexpected wage losses.

options.label: D
options.text: The people would become too dependent on support from the government.

visual_elements: Excerpt from remarks by New York Rep. James Wadsworth Jr., April 19, 1935, about Social Security Act of 1935
